sections.text:
Ability Power 100. Damages all enemies 3 times with time-elemental physical damage with a success value of 100.
-Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Heals the HP of all allies with Ability Power 60.
-Removes all status ailments from all allies.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 100-Ability-Power attack that deals physical time damage to all enemies 3 times with a success value of 100 by 50.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the stats of all allies by 20% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Recovers 15 Cost for all allies.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 3500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 3500
Only [Glorious Blossoms] Ouka can be used as Unlocking Potential material
